scope: Durable manual Bot/group creation and explicit original-result recovery

behavior.atomicity: Bot, its original DM, avatar publication and receipt commit together. Group and receipt commit together. Live original identity, owner-only fresh Bot creation and shared members rechecked before commit. No model or tasks start.
behavior.idempotence: Actor/request identity binds a digest and immutable entity IDs. Changed payloads conflict. Retry and restart return current original entities, without restoring deleted results.
behavior.cancellation: A durable tombstone rejects late create attempts. Cancelling accepted work only returns its receipt. GET 404 never automatically permits a new request.
behavior.ui: One intent per user/workspace stored as metadata only. Frozen body stays in memory. Same-ID retries are explicit after checking; reopen/reload reads only. Creation success, navigation and refresh failures are distinct. Opening rechecks current entities.
behavior.roles: Members create groups. Only a live owner creates a fresh Bot. A creator who remains a member can recover an accepted Bot receipt after demotion.

guiBlocker: Browser works; authenticated product acceptance awaits explicit consent for a synthetic temporary account after automatic approval review rejected creation.
